text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to flip the `per_tenant_cache` feature flag to ON for the canary tenant cohort tonight at 23:00 PST. Goal: validate cache hit improvement on canaries before wider rollout.

raj: Ack. Which tenants are included in canary and how are we measuring success? latency and error rate targets?

maria: Canaries = tenant_ids [1001,1008,1020]. Success: p95 latency drop >= 10% and error rate < 0.1% over 30m window. Also check SLO traces for cache misses.

kevin: I can perform the flip and watch dashboards. I will run the smoke script immediately after flip. My watch window: +30m.

anika: I'll be standing by for rollback if any customers report problems. Please post the rollback command here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: action=flag_flip user=kevin target=per_tenant_cache cohort=canary time=1961235600 (23:00 PST)

kevin: Execute steps below. I'll run them in #eng-oncall too.

kevin:
```
# flip to true for canary tenants
ri-admin flags set per_tenant_cache true --tenants=1001,1008,1020 --env=prod
# run smoke checks
./tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --cohort canary --timeout 300
# quick curl to verify behavior
curl -s "https://api.redwood.example/v1/health?tenant=1001" | jq .cache_status
```

maria: Good. Add a short circuit-breaker in case KV store latency spikes:
```
ri-admin config set cache.circuit_breaker.max_latency_ms 300 --env=prod
ri-admin config set cache.fallback_to_global true --env=prod
```

raj: FYI, I've pushed a small monitoring alert to watch for increased downstream DB qps when cache miss rate rises. Alert: "cache_miss_qps > 100 for 5m".

kevin: Smoke run results (after flip):
- smoke script: 29/30 checks passed
- p95 latency: 480ms -> 420ms (approx 12.5% improvement)
- one tenant (1008) had a slow path: 1 request timed out (5xx)

sre-bot: Incident bot note: Elevated 5xx on tenant=1008 detected at 1961234720. Linked runbook: https://confluence.redwood/caching/runbooks/slow-tenant

anika: For rollback do this (will be ready to run):
```
# rollback to OFF for all tenants if we need to abort
ri-admin flags set per_tenant_cache false --all --env=prod
# optionally restore previous config
ri-admin config set cache.fallback_to_global false --env=prod
```

kevin: Plan: keep flag ON for canary for 60m, monitor metrics/dashboard + traces. If more than 2 errors or p95 regression > 5% in 30m, we rollback immediately. I'll ping here and in #incidents if we abort.

maria: Sounds good. @anika you'll be primary rollback executor if kevin can't? 

anika: Affirmative. I'm on-call and reachable via phone if needed. :phone:

maria: Final note — we're not exposing this to Dedicated customers yet. No changes to routing. If all good at +60m, we'll schedule a 10% ramp tomorrow morning.

kevin: Flipping now (23:05 PST). Will post final status in ~30m. :rocket:

kevin: 30m update: metrics stable, no customer impact observed. p95 net improvement sustained. Marking this canary flip as SUCCESS. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll create a short postmortem-style note in the rollout doc and open a PR to promote the flag to 10% tomorrow.
